subject: Small sync glitch before club prep
text: Hey there, quick one. When I try to sync our club meeting notes from the shared folder, the mobile app keeps stalling at about ninety percent and then flashes that vague connection hiccup message. I have already restarted my phone, turned mobile data off and back on, and even swapped to my phone hotspot, but nothing sticks. On the desktop it uploads fine, so I reckon it is something small with the mobile cache or permissions. Any chance you have seen this before or know a quick workaround before tonight prep session? Happy to send screenshots if it helps. No rush at all, just hoping for a magic fix.
